description: This file defines types, functions, and exports related to bundled plugin build entries, including data structures and functions for listing and collecting build entries, artifacts, and dependencies.

methods.name: export function collectBundledPluginBuildEntries( collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Collects and returns an array of BundledPluginBuildEntry objects based on optional parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Returns a record mapping build entry identifiers to string values, based on optional parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Lists the packaging artifacts for bundled plugins based on optional parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Lists runtime dependency strings for bundled plugins, based on optional parameters.
